metadata.title: Clicked like a confused hamster and somehow stole 1 kill? Valorant’s aim went wild again
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I lost the plot
Enemy: probably questioning all life choices
Valorant just handed me a miracle kill out of chaos
If your aim ever surprises you, you get this!

Tap if your aim’s as confused as mine!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
